blocks.text: Businesses in the Philippines may soon benefit from more streamlined administrative and financial processes following the partnership between Timora HRIS and Payroll System and Juan by JuanTax, two local technology providers seeking to expand access to integrated digital business solutions. The partnership aims to address the operational demands of companies by bringing together technologies for human resource management, payroll processing, accounting, and tax compliance. Through their respective platforms, the companies intend to help businesses improve record management, minimize repetitive tasks, and make information-sharing between departments more efficient. Beyond their software offerings, the collaboration will include joint training sessions and educational initiatives […]...
